integrity: All proof claims are supported by the stated induction; finite executable cross-checks do not establish infinite correctness. No independent verification or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite simple forests; does not count EOP sets on arbitrary cyclic graphs.
The induced-star structural relation itself is established in prior literature; new claim is the disjoint all-coefficient counting recursion.
The stated cubic runtime is an integer-arithmetic-operation bound, not binary-bit complexity.
Unindexed or unpublished equivalent derivations are a residual originality risk.
title: An exact five-state edge-open-packing polynomial recursion for forests
